summary.en-US: Sweeps junk out of Gmail: bulk rules plus optional AI triage that trashes junk, labels what you keep and suggests unsubscribes. Use a local Ollama model (nothing leaves your machine) or a cloud provider you choose.

description.en-US:
Inbox Broom cleans your Gmail inbox by **driving the Gmail web page the way you would by hand**: it runs searches, ticks rows and clicks Archive, Delete, Label and Unsubscribe. No Google API, no OAuth, no account to create.

**How it works:** Preview → review page (edit verdicts, labels, subscriptions) → Confirm. Nothing is permanently deleted: junk goes to Gmail's Trash (30-day undo), and any run can be undone from the popup for 7 days.

**Features**

- **Bulk rules**: one Gmail search per rule (Promotions, Social, old OTP mails…), trashed thousands at a time.
- **AI triage** (optional): sender, subject and a short preview of each remaining inbox row are classified junk / keep; only junk is trashed.
- **Labels**: every kept mail gets one label, preferring your existing Gmail labels.
- **Retention**: per-label inbox lifetimes; archived, starred and important mail is never touched.
- **Unsubscribe**: suggests senders you never open and clicks Gmail's own Unsubscribe.
- **Review page**: flip verdicts, change labels, always-delete / always-keep per sender, then one Confirm.
- **Undo**: restore any run from the last 7 days.

**AI providers**

- **Ollama** (default): runs on your own computer, nothing leaves your machine. Start it with `OLLAMA_ORIGINS="moz-extension://*" ollama serve`.
- **OpenAI-compatible** or **Anthropic** (opt-in, your own API key): Firefox asks you to allow sending email data to that provider before anything is sent.

Without any AI, bulk rules still work.

**Requirements:** Gmail web UI in English. Keep the Gmail tab open while a run is in progress.

Open source (MIT): https://github.com/shivangrathore/inboxbroom

version.approval_notes:
Source is plain, unminified JavaScript with no build step (the package is a zip of the repo files: https://github.com/shivangrathore/inboxbroom). No remote code.

The content script on mail.google.com automates Gmail's own UI (search, select, Trash, Label as, Unsubscribe) after the user previews and confirms in the review page. AI triage is optional: by default it calls a local Ollama server on localhost:11434. Cloud providers (OpenAI-compatible endpoint or api.anthropic.com) are opt-in with the user's own API key; the options page requests the host permission together with the optional 'personalCommunications' data collection permission, and the background refuses to send anything to a non-local provider until that permission is granted.

To test: install, open Gmail (English UI), click the toolbar icon → Preview. Bulk rules work without any AI configured.
